            max_row = max(max_row, cell.row)
            max_col = max(max_col, cell.column)

print("Sheets:", wb_vals.sheetnames)

# Helper functions for XLSX XML manipulation that preserves untouched files/parts exactly.
main_ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
rel_ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships"
pkg_rel_ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"
ET.register_namespace("", main_ns)
ET.register_namespace("r", rel_ns)

def ns_tag(ns, tag):
    return f"{{{ns}}}{tag}"

def col_index_from_ref(cell_ref):
    letters = ''.join(ch for ch in cell_ref if ch.isalpha()).upper()
    idx = 0
    for ch in letters:
        idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - ord('A') + 1)
    return idx

def row_num_from_ref(cell_ref):
    return int(''.join(ch for ch in cell_ref if ch.isdigit()))

def find_sheet_xml_path(xlsx_path, desired_sheet_name):
    with ZipFile(xlsx_path, "r") as zin:
        wb_xml = ET.fromstring(zin.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
        rels_xml = ET.fromstring(zin.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
        rel_targets = {}
        for rel in rels_xml:
            rid = rel.attrib.get("Id")
            target = rel.attrib.get("Target")
            if rid and target:
                if target.startswith("/"):
                    target_path = target.lstrip("/")
                else:
                    target_path = "xl/" + target
                rel_targets[rid] = target_path.replace("\\", "/")
        for sheet in wb_xml.findall(f".//{ns_tag(main_ns, 'sheet')}"):
            if sheet.attrib.get("name") == desired_sheet_name:
                rid = sheet.attrib.get(ns_tag(rel_ns, "id"))
                return rel_targets[rid]
    raise ValueError(f"Could not find worksheet XML path for {desired_sheet_name}")

sheet_xml_path = find_sheet_xml_path(input_path, sheet_name)
print("Worksheet XML path:", sheet_xml_path)

# Copy xlsx while replacing only the relevant worksheet XML.
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with ZipFile(input_path, "r") as zin:
    sheet_xml_bytes = zin.read(sheet_xml_path)
    root = ET.fromstring(sheet_xml_bytes)
    sheet_data = root.find(ns_tag(main_ns, "sheetData"))
    if sheet_data is None:
        raise ValueError("sheetData not found")

    # Map existing rows and cells
    rows_by_num = {}
    for row_el in sheet_data.findall(ns_tag(main_ns, "row")):
        r_attr = row_el.attrib.get("r")
        if r_attr:
            rows_by_num[int(r_attr)] = row_el

    def get_or_create_row(r):
        if r in rows_by_num:
            return rows_by_num[r]
        new_row = ET.Element(ns_tag(main_ns, "row"), {"r": str(r)})
        # Insert in row-number order
        inserted = False
        children = list(sheet_data)
        for idx, child in enumerate(children):
            if child.tag == ns_tag(main_ns, "row") and int(child.attrib.get("r", "0")) > r:
                sheet_data.insert(idx, new_row)
                inserted = True
                break
        if not inserted:
            sheet_data.append(new_row)
        rows_by_num[r] = new_row
        return new_row

    def get_or_create_cell(cell_ref):
        r = row_num_from_ref(cell_ref)
        col_idx = col_index_from_ref(cell_ref)
        row_el = get_or_create_row(r)
        for c_el in row_el.findall(ns_tag(main_ns, "c")):
            if c_el.attrib.get("r") == cell_ref:
                return c_el
        new_c = ET.Element(ns_tag(main_ns, "c"), {"r": cell_ref})
        # Insert in column order within row
        inserted = False
        children = list(row_el)
        for idx, child in enumerate(children):
            if child.tag == ns_tag(main_ns, "c"):
                child_ref = child.attrib.get("r", "")
                if child_ref and col_index_from_ref(child_ref) > col_idx:
                    row_el.insert(idx, new_c)
                    inserted = True
                    break
        if not inserted:
            row_el.append(new_c)
        return new_c

    def set_numeric_cell(cell_ref, number):
        c_el = get_or_create_cell(cell_ref)
        # Set as a plain numeric cell. Keep style if present, but remove formula/string markers.
        c_el.attrib.pop("t", None)
        c_el.attrib.pop("cm", None)
        c_el.attrib.pop("vm", None)
        for child in list(c_el):
            if child.tag in (ns_tag(main_ns, "v"), ns_tag(main_ns, "f"), ns_tag(main_ns, "is")):
                c_el.remove(child)
        v_el = ET.SubElement(c_el, ns_tag(main_ns, "v"))
        v_el.text = repr(float(number)) if isinstance(number, float) else str(number)

    for ref, value in writes.items():
        set_numeric_cell(ref, value)

    new_sheet_xml = ET.tostring(root, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)

    # Write a new XLSX preserving all other archive members byte-for-byte.
    with ZipFile(output_path, "w", ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
